newsitem.title: UK: Compass Group says unit buys N.L. Catering.
newsitem.headline: Compass Group says unit buys N.L. Catering.

text.p: British catering company Compass Group Plc said on Thursday its wholly owned subsidiary Letheby and Christopher had acquired National Leisure Catering for 11 million stg in cash.
NLC specialises in providing catering at a number of British sporting events including at Wembley Stadium and the Oval Cricket ground.
National Leisure had reported a pre-tax, pre-interest profit of 1.7 million stg on a turnover of 19.4 million for the year ended December 31, 1996.
"The acquisition strategically reinforces Letheby and Christopher's market leadership in sports and events catering," Fritz Ternofsky, chief executive of Compass' UK division said.
